primary.rule: H1 supported if family max-T p < 0.05 in lung AND in lung_external (CONVENTION3 s4)

replication_criterion.rule: lung_external statistic has the same sign as lung and its interval excludes the null value (CONVENTION3 s1); evaluated on the lung_external direction best matched by |cos| of right-singular vectors to each lung top-3 cell

bridge_kidneyA.description: zero-row full SVD; 187 legacy genes; functional STRING>=0.7; co-pole K=0.27n; label shuffle
S1 + physical STRING>=700 among the 187 (off-path check)
S1 + universe V (poles and shuffle over V); same functional pairs
S3 + scalar assortativity r (label shuffle, two-sided)
S4 + Maslov-Sneppen null (primary H1 kidney_A run, N=2,000; max-T here over SV2-SV4 only)
